response: This is yet another glaring example of progressive elites in France weaponizing the state to dismantle our most essential traditions and institutions. In Paris, Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame, has now been convicted under this new law on psychological subjection. It shows how they are abusing vague statutes to undermine the Church's proper authority and the family values it has long protected. This amounts to a serious attack on social order and cultural continuity, as government officials interfere to silence religious leaders who defend longstanding moral principles instead of embracing the left's radical modern ideologies.
